scope: Claim-driven supplementary audit for the balanced2s-material determinantal quotient; parent PI analysis, no claim of exhaustive literature search

sources.title: Maximal minors of a matrix with linear form entries
sources.authors: Hiroya Ito; Atsushi Noma; Masahiro Ohno
sources.access: Publisher abstract in search index; direct page request403; fulltext not inspected
sources.relevance: Existing result connects maximal rank away fromorigin to spanning degree-m homogeneous forms by maximal minors. This directly limits claims that the leading-block spanning mechanism is new.

sources.title: Canonical complexes associated to a matrix
sources.access: Author preprint abstract inspected; background Eagon-Northcott complexes explicitly described
sources.relevance: The determinantal resolution and its depth/grade conditions are established algebra. Our conditional quotient length is a specialization, not a new Eagon-Northcott theorem.

sources.title: Optimized Groebner basis algorithms for maximal determinantal ideals and critical point computations
sources.authors: Sriram Gopalakrishnan; Vincent Neiger; Mohab Safey El Din
sources.relevance: Determinantal structure and Eagon-Northcott syzygies already inform dedicated polynomial algorithms; ordinary multistart is not a complete algebraic state-of-art comparator.

judgment: A broader balanced-Maxwell physical reduction can strengthen scope, but does not confer global novelty on quotient construction, determinantal degree, or eigenvalue root extraction. A structured algebraic comparator remains important.
